open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 — OffsetTimeOriginal parsing
open_points.text: `DateTimeOriginal` uses `OffsetTimeOriginal` when that offset matches the imported `EXIF_OFFSET_PATTERN` constant whole, with hours up to the imported `CAMERA_OFFSET_MAX_HOURS` constant and minutes up to 59
open_points.question: After the pattern matches, how are the sign, hours and minutes extracted so that the numeric limits can be checked?
options: Require the pattern to expose specified named capture groups
Define a fixed offset representation and parse its fixed positions
Let each implementation infer the components from the pattern
open_points.default_guess: Require named `sign`, `hours` and `minutes` capture groups in the pattern contract.

open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 — EXIF camera datetime parsing
open_points.text: A camera value is unusable when it does not match the imported `EXIF_DATETIME_PATTERN` constant whole or is no valid calendar date and time
open_points.question: Once the value matches the pattern, what representation or capture-group contract determines its year, month, day, hour, minute and second for calendar validation and conversion?
options: Require specified named capture groups in the pattern
Specify a fixed datetime representation parsed after matching
Let implementations infer a parser from the pattern text
open_points.default_guess: Specify one fixed EXIF datetime representation and use the pattern only to validate it.

open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 — maximum offset minutes
open_points.text: with hours up to the imported `CAMERA_OFFSET_MAX_HOURS` constant and minutes up to 59
open_points.rule: У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The literal policy threshold 59 must become an imported provider constant, named in the required `the imported X constant` form.
